name: 98274 · Mount Vernon, WA
findings: ZIP 98274 (Mount Vernon) has 56 nonprofit organizations. 25 of them (45%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 20 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (23% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 98274 (Mount Vernon) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 98274 (Mount Vernon) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.7 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 17 organizations here; 36% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are ways to volunteer so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
